description: Write (treat as a sensitive, purchase-starting action; confirm the tier, price, and product links with the person first). Saves a pending testing order and creates a secure Stripe-hosted checkout link for it. Nothing is charged by this call: the person must open checkout_url and pay. Use get_checkout_status to see whether they paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional key; repeating a call with the same key and arguments returns the same checkout.

products.description: Products to test (at most the tier’s product count), each a public http(s) product page.

name: create_testing_checkout
title: Create testing order checkout link
